description: This file defines utility classes and templates for input validation, including ExpectedValues, Validator, and ValidationManager, within the Utils namespace. It provides mechanisms for validating data types against expected ranges, regex patterns, or custom functions, and managing multiple validators.

classes.name: ExpectedValues
classes.description: Template class for representing expected values of a type, supporting discrete sets, ranges, and regex patterns, with validation methods.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Template class for validating values of type T, supporting expected values and custom validation functions, inheriting from ValidatorBase.

classes.name: ValidationManager
classes.description: Class managing multiple validators identified by string keys, allowing addition, validation, and logging of validation results.

methods.name: ExpectedValues
methods.description: Constructors for creating ExpectedValues objects with ranges, regex, or discrete sets.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Method to validate a value against the expected criteria.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory methods to create Validator instances with expected values or custom functions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Method to validate a value using the validator.

methods.name: addValidator
methods.description: Methods to add validators to the ValidationManager.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets a custom logging function for validation results.
